issue_gist: Frequency.addValue(Object) accepts non-Comparable objects (e.g. a plain Object) on the first add, and failure only occurs on a later add with IllegalArgumentException. getCount/getPct silently return 0 for non-Comparable objects, and getCumFreq/getCumPct only work with Comparable. The API should require Comparable and reject non-Comparable values immediately.
